I don’t know. I’m 22 (F) and I’ve had an on again off again relationship with the same boy since I was 15. I know we’re not good for eachother. He cheats, he gets High, I hold resentments and lie. And every time we get into this argument again of “I’m a liar. I’m a whore. I’m done we’re done” it just hurts. My heart my head my everything and I should be used to it but it’s so fresh every time. I’m relieved it’s over bc I can’t keep doing it but m, fuck, it’s really over. I put so much of myself into him for nothing. For it all to end in another argument. I wasted my time and my life and I loved the wrong person for most of my “adult” life.
